answer: Use ship logbook tenure with voyage entry archive as the proof: voyages entered in one logbook across years. One fake is cheap, but 345 aliases need 345 independent voyage archives, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The voyage check runs in the open: 345 fakes pay the full price 345 times, one honest agent pays once, and the delta trail in the ledger makes the quill cost visible to everyone.
